submission.justification: Absorber-F3 at 6 mm gives the best energy resolution among the simulated options at 100 GeV (3.23%, the minimum of the F3 scan and lower than F2 and F1 at every thickness tested). It is a conditional recommendation. The hard residual dose-rate limit (20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week of cooldown) has not been verified: no dose-rate data or activation documents were available (dose_rate_data_available_count = 0, activation_doc_count = 0, s5_dose_limit_verified = 0). Option F3 must not be adopted until an activation/dose calculation confirms the limit at 6 mm. If F3 fails the dose limit, the next candidate to check is F2 at 5 mm (3.84%), then F1. Minor discrepancy noted: the 5 mm F3 value in the summary (3.2%) differs from the scan value (3.269%); the scan value was used here.
